description: Borrower experienced a 90-days-past-due delinquency or worse within two years of the observation.
available_at_prediction: No (this is the outcome being predicted)
planned_treatment: Use as the binary target; positive class is the default event, so no remapping

description: Balance on credit cards and personal lines of credit divided by the sum of credit limits.
valid_range_or_values: Expected 0 to ~1; a few rows reach ~50708 (data error)
planned_treatment: Keep; log-transform the skew and cap/flag implausible extreme values

description: Age of the borrower in years.
valid_range_or_values: Expected ~18 to ~110; one row has an invalid age of 0
planned_treatment: Drop the single age==0 row; add bucketed age_band as a feature

description: Number of times 30-59 days past due, but not worse, in the last two years.
valid_range_or_values: Expected 0 to ~20; sentinel codes 96 and 98 appear
missing_value_meaning: No NaN, but 96/98 act as sentinel error codes
planned_treatment: Recode 96/98 to missing with a had_sentinel_delinquency_code flag; fold into total_past_due

description: Monthly debt payments, alimony and living costs divided by monthly gross income.
valid_range_or_values: Expected 0 to ~2; a few rows reach ~329664 (data error)
planned_treatment: Keep; log-transform and cap/flag implausible extreme values

description: Self-reported monthly income of the borrower.
valid_range_or_values: Non-negative, with a long right tail
missing_value_meaning: NaN means income was not reported
planned_treatment: Add monthly_income_missing flag, then median-impute inside the training fold; log-transform

description: Number of open instalment loans (e.g. car loan, mortgage) and lines of credit (e.g. credit cards).
Number of times the borrower was 90 days or more past due.
valid_range_or_values: Expected 0 to ~20; sentinel codes 96 and 98 appear
missing_value_meaning: No NaN, but 96/98 act as sentinel error codes
planned_treatment: Recode 96/98 to missing with a flag; fold into total_past_due

description: Number of mortgage and real-estate loans, including home-equity lines of credit.
Number of times 60-89 days past due, but not worse, in the last two years.
valid_range_or_values: Expected 0 to ~20; sentinel codes 96 and 98 appear
missing_value_meaning: No NaN, but 96/98 act as sentinel error codes
planned_treatment: Recode 96/98 to missing with a flag; fold into total_past_due

description: Number of dependents in the family excluding the borrower (spouse, children, etc.).
missing_value_meaning: NaN means the count was not reported
planned_treatment: Add a missingness flag, then median-impute inside the training fold
